evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.

{{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.

Innate: Amumu's basic attacks and Curse of the Sad Mummy are empowered to mark enemies with Curse for 3 seconds ... / Cursed targets receive 10% bonus true damage from all incoming pre-mitigation magic damage.

Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
every damage event carries one damage type (physical/magic/true), zero or more script tags ...

No occurrence of 'Abyssal', 'Unmake', 'Mandate', 'aura', 'curse' or 'support_damage' anywhere in the document (523 lines, grep -i). The doc carries no rule that governs this leaf; the formula-audit table covers mitigation, penetration, growth, AS, haste, renewal counting, DoT, GW, shields, grey health, revive, BIS — not ally/support amplification.

independent_computation.step_1_magnitude: Unmake's amplification is 12% increased damage taken (S1, S2, S4). As a multiplicative damage modifier (S7) that is 1 + 0.12 = 1.12. The magnitude 1.12 in the old value is therefore exactly right for the effect itself, and the item is not stale (S9).
independent_computation.step_2_type_gate: Unmake's amplification is typed: both the wiki branch text and the Riot description say 'magic damage' (S1, S2), and the calculator's own cached atomization files Unmake under atom_id 'damage.magic' (S3, S4). Every damage event carries exactly one type (S8). Therefore the 1.12 multiplier is admissible ONLY on a magic-damage event; on a physical or true event it must not appear at all (not 1.0-with-source, absent).
independent_computation.step_3_target_gate: Unmake curses 'Enemy champions within 700 units of you' (S1). Two further conditions: the damaged unit must be an enemy CHAMPION, and it must be inside the 700-unit aura of the Abyssal Mask holder. A damage event against a non-champion, or outside the aura, carries no Unmake multiplier.
independent_computation.step_4_roster_composition: The scenario name resolves to three distinct amp sources in the cached data: Imperial Mandate 'Command' (+7% from ALL sources, all damage types, but only inside a 4 s Vulnerable window opened by an immobilize — S5), Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' (+12%, magic only, always-on aura — S1), and a 'Curse' whose only cached amp-like referent is Amumu's Cursed Touch, which is NOT a multiplier at all: it adds 10% of incoming pre-mitigation magic damage as a separate TRUE-damage packet (S6). Composition, if two multipliers coexist, is multiplicative (S7): a magic event inside the Vulnerable window would read 1.12 × 1.07 = 1.1984.
independent_computation.step_5_what_absence_implies: The old leaf listed Abyssal ALONE (1.12) with no Mandate factor, which is only self-consistent if event 23 lies outside the Vulnerable window (Mandate is type-agnostic — S5 — so it cannot be excluded by damage type). Given Mandate is already out at event 23, the field going fully absent is exactly what the rules require when the event's damage type is not magic (or the target is not a cursed enemy champion in range): the only remaining candidate multiplier, Unmake, is gated off by its magic-only typing (S3/S4/S8). Notably, the third roster effect is itself a TRUE-damage packet derived from magic damage (S6) — a true-typed event of exactly this kind is the archetypal leaf on which a magic-only amp must not be listed, and attaching 1.12 to it would double-count the amplification already carried by the magic base it was computed from.
independent_computation.conclusion: 1.12 is the correct magnitude of Unmake but it is a typed, conditional modifier, not a fight-wide multiplier. Nothing in the cached data licenses applying it to a non-magic event; absence is the correct rendering of the leaf whenever the event is physical or true, or the target is not a cursed enemy champion inside 700 units. The removal is the shape of a correct type/target gate, and no cached source supports the unconditional presence the old value implied.
independent_computation.residual_uncertainty: The oracle export (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md) does not contain the scenario definition or the event list — those live under scripts/ and tests/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids reading. I therefore could not read the damage TYPE of combat/events[23] directly. The verdict is conditional in exactly one respect: if event 23 is a magic-damage event against a cursed enemy champion inside the 700-unit aura, then the correct value is 1.12 (or 1.1984 if a Mandate Vulnerable window covers it) and the removal would be a regression. Every other case — physical event, true event (including the Cursed-Touch true packet), non-champion or out-of-aura target — makes absence correct. Reasons the evidence favours the latter: the field vanished entirely rather than dropping to Mandate's type-agnostic 1.07, which means BOTH candidate multipliers were gated off at event 23, and the only gate that can remove Unmake while leaving its magnitude correct elsewhere is its magic-only typing, which the repo's own cached atomization already records (S3, S4).
